message.content:
I don’t have real‑time data built into this chat, so I can’t tell you the exact Air Quality Index (AQI) for Los Angeles at this moment.  
Here’s what you can do to get the most up‑to‑date information:

| Source | How to check |
|--------|--------------|
| **AirNow** (U.S. EPA) | Visit <https://www.airnow.gov/> and enter “Los Angeles” or your ZIP code. |
| **AQICN** (World Air Quality Index) | Go to <https://aqicn.org/city/los-angeles/>. |
| **Weather apps** (e.g., Weather.com, AccuWeather, or your phone’s weather widget) | Many include an AQI reading. |
| **Local news** | TV or online news sites often report on smog levels during high‑pollution days. |

If you’re looking for a quick snapshot, you can also use a voice assistant (Google Assistant, Siri, Alexa) and ask, “What’s the air quality in Los Angeles?” They pull the latest data from the EPA or other air‑quality APIs.
